Project Overview

A modern website created to present the brand with clarity, confidence, and premium digital appeal.

Better Ceasons needed a website that could communicate a purpose-led message in a simple, structured, and visually polished way. The goal was to create a website that feels clean, premium, responsive, and easy to explore.

D’Genius Solutions developed the website with a modern frontend and CMS-backed structure. This gave Better Ceasons a strong digital platform for storytelling, education, content publishing, SEO visibility, AI search readiness, and future expansion.

SEO, AEO, GEO & AI Readiness

Built to support modern search visibility and AI discovery.

The Better Ceasons website was planned with a modern search-first approach that supports traditional Google SEO and emerging AI-driven discovery platforms.

01

SEO Optimized

Clean structure, crawl-friendly sections, optimized content flow, and strong page hierarchy support better search engine visibility.

02

AEO Ready

Answer-focused content blocks help the website become easier for answer engines and AI search systems to understand.

03

GEO Support

The website content structure supports generative engine optimization by making brand topics, context, and entities clearer.

04

LLM SEO

Clear topic mapping, readable content sections, and structured messaging help large language models better interpret the website.

05

AI Readiness

The website is structured to make important brand information easier for AI systems to process and recommend.

06

AI Overview Friendly

Clear answers, strong topical relevance, and organized sections support better readiness for Google AI Overview-style visibility.

07

Voice Search Ready

Conversational content flow supports voice-style queries and answer-based discovery.

08

AI Platforms

The website is prepared for visibility across AI platforms that rely on clear, structured, and context-rich website information.

The Challenge

Creating a website that feels premium while keeping the message simple.

01

Content Clarity

The brand message needed to be explained clearly without making the website feel heavy, confusing, or overly technical.

02

Premium Visual Identity

The interface needed a high-end dark theme that looked refined and aligned with a modern digital presentation.

03

CMS Flexibility

The client needed WordPress CMS support so content could be updated after launch without disturbing the frontend experience.

04

Responsive UX

The website needed to stay clean, readable, and professional across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.

Our Solution

Custom website development powered by a modern, scalable technology stack.

D’Genius Solutions built the website with Next.js, React.js, HTML5, CSS, JavaScript, Node.js, GSAP, Babel, and WordPress. This stack allowed the website to combine performance, design control, animation, responsiveness, CMS flexibility, and search-ready architecture.

  • Custom frontend development using Next.js and React.js.
  • WordPress CMS integration for easy content management.
  • Responsive layouts for desktop, tablet, and mobile screens.
  • GSAP motion effects for a more premium and interactive feel.
  • SEO, AEO, GEO, LLM SEO, and AI readiness support.
  • Scalable structure for future content and page expansion.

Development Process

How D’Genius Solutions built the Better Ceasons website.

01

Requirement Understanding

We studied the project goals, audience needs, website purpose, content flow, visual direction, search goals, and required functionality.

02

Website Structure Planning

We planned the page flow, content hierarchy, section layout, responsive structure, and search-friendly content architecture.

03

Frontend Development

The frontend was developed with Next.js, React.js, HTML5, CSS, and JavaScript for a modern and flexible website experience.

04

WordPress CMS Integration

WordPress was used as the CMS layer so the client can manage website content from the backend.

05

SEO & AI Readiness Layer

The website structure was refined for SEO, AEO, GEO, LLM SEO, AI Overview readiness, voice search, and AI platform discovery.

06

Testing and Launch

The website was tested for responsiveness, spacing, browser compatibility, visual consistency, search readiness, and deployment quality.

Project Outcome

A premium, responsive, and AI-ready website for Better Ceasons.

The final website gives Better Ceasons a strong digital foundation for brand storytelling, awareness-led content, user engagement, search visibility, AI discovery, and future content growth.

Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know about our services. Can't find the answer you're looking for? Feel free to reach out.

We offer comprehensive web design and development services including custom website design, WordPress development, e-commerce solutions, SEO optimization, social media marketing, and ongoing maintenance. Our team specializes in creating premium, conversion-focused websites tailored to your business needs.

Timelines vary based on project complexity. A standard business website typically takes 4–6 weeks, while more complex e-commerce or custom web applications can take 8–12 weeks. We follow a structured process: discovery (1–2 weeks), design (2–3 weeks), development (2–4 weeks), and testing/launch (1 week).

Our pricing is project-based and tailored to your specific requirements. Basic business websites start from ₹50,000, while custom enterprise solutions vary based on scope. We provide detailed quotes after understanding your needs during a free consultation. All projects include responsive design, SEO fundamentals, and training.

We'll audit your current site, identify improvement areas, preserve your SEO rankings, and modernize the design while maintaining your brand identity. Our redesign process includes UX improvements, performance optimization, and updated content strategy.
